title: PLAYER 2 HUNTS THE SAME GOLDEN ENEMY
why: His order of 2026-10-14: the raid flow batch must work for both players. The golden enemy and its clue hunt were worked out by each window for itself, from where each player stood, so the two players could hunt two different golden machines with two different sets of clues, and the fall of the real one was announced to the host alone. The host now says which body is gilded and how the hunt stands, and the linked window keeps exactly that: the same golden machine with its shine, the same three props, the same search circle on the minimap and the map. Player 2 can take a clue too: it is said in his window at once and told to the host, which marks it for both and shrinks the circle for both. When the golden enemy falls GOLDEN ENEMY DOWN is said to both, the hunt ends, and the hoard is marked on both maps.
now: Player 2 now hunts the same golden enemy as player 1 and finds the same clues.
